_comment: Copy to config.json and edit, or run: python scripts/setup.py
_tracker_help: Leave empty. setup.py creates a Google Sheet and fills this in with its spreadsheet ID (not a filename anymore).
_hebrew_cv_template_help: Optional. Full path (or workdir-relative) to YOUR Hebrew CV as a .docx. Required only for Hebrew CV generation — see docs/HEBREW_CV_TEMPLATE.md for the rules the file must follow.
_google_credentials_help: Workdir-relative path to the OAuth client JSON you download from Google Cloud Console — one-time setup, see docs/GOOGLE_SETUP.md.
_google_token_help: Workdir-relative path where the cached Google sign-in token is stored after the first run. Created automatically — never commit or share this file.
_search_titles_help: The role titles the crawlers search for. Hebrew titles work too.
_linkedin_geo_id_help: 101620260 = Israel. Leave as is for the Israeli market.
_exclude_locations_help: Optional list of place names (Hebrew or English) to auto-skip, e.g. cities too far to commute. Matched against the job's location field.
_min_score_help: Jobs scoring below this (0-100 fit vs your profile) are not written to the tracker.
_generate_score_floor_help: CV/cover packages are generated only for candidates at or above this score, and only when you mark Gen CV = Y in the tracker.
_language_default_help: auto = Hebrew job description gets a Hebrew CV, otherwise English.
_role_keywords_help: Jobify360 only: keywords matched against role-tab titles on /myjobs (Hebrew or English). Empty = sensible operations/supply-chain defaults.
